desc:
🚦 Build your dream city. Control the traffic!

Flow City is a city-building traffic puzzle where you draw roads, plan bus routes, run metro trains and connect airports. Grow a skyline of skyscrapers and keep rush hour moving! New homes and shops bring commuters every day.

🏙️ BUILD YOUR NETWORK
• Connect homes and shops with roads and public transport
• Beat jams with traffic lights, roundabouts, bridges and highways

🎮 FOUR MODES
• Rush Hour: Survive growing traffic
• Metropolis: Manage money, power and water
• Endless: Creative sandbox with no game over
• Compete: 1v1 or 4-player city battles. Sabotage rivals; last city standing wins!

🚆 EXPLORE IN 3D
Walk the streets, ride the subway, board a plane or drive your car. Unlock cars, map themes and skins, and climb the leaderboards.

Your city. Your routes. Keep it flowing!

Tags: City Builder, Traffic Puzzle, Road Building, Public Transport, Strategy, Sandbox, Metro Trains, Bus Routes, City Management, Multiplayer
